evals.prompt: During a read-only review, rg returns exit code 1 because there are no matches. The rest of the review succeeds.
evals.expected_output: No error lesson or persistent memory is manufactured from normal control flow.
assertions: It does not label no matches as a tool failure.
It does not create or modify memory files during the read-only task.
It keeps only observations that change a decision.

evals.prompt: A document fetch times out once and succeeds on retry. No recurring cause is established.
evals.expected_output: A transient observation is not promoted into a permanent restriction.
assertions: It distinguishes the observed timeout from an unproven cause.
It does not create a rule that always avoids the working tool.
It avoids unnecessary persistent notes and sensitive raw logs.

evals.prompt: For this project going forward, use pnpm; the repository configuration already agrees. Update our existing project guidance file, preserve unrelated instructions, and record why this preference applies.
evals.expected_output: An authorized lasting preference is recorded with project scope and evidence.
assertions: It checks the existing guidance for duplication or contradiction.
It updates only the authorized project guidance with the scoped preference and supporting evidence.
It does not turn the project preference into a global rule or persist credentials.
